description: This file implements a command-line interface for managing NVRAM (Non-Volatile RAM) settings, including commands like show, info, get, set, unset, and commit. It interacts with external NVRAM handling functions and provides user command parsing.

methods.name: nvram_open_rdonly
methods.description: Opens NVRAM in read-only mode, trying staging first, then MTD if staging is unavailable.

methods.name: nvram_open_staging
methods.description: Opens NVRAM in staging mode if available or prepares staging area.

methods.name: do_show
methods.description: Prints all key-value pairs stored in NVRAM.

methods.name: do_get
methods.description: Retrieves and prints the value of a specified NVRAM variable.

methods.name: do_unset
methods.description: Removes a specified variable from NVRAM.

methods.name: do_set
methods.description: Sets a variable in NVRAM with a specified value.

methods.name: do_info
methods.description: Displays detailed header information about the NVRAM.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the CLI.
